_meta.title: IEC 60364-5-52:2009 Annex B current-carrying capacities and correction factors (+ IEC 60364-4-43 Table 43A, IEC 60228 R20, conventional currents)
_meta.standard_edition: IEC 60364-5-52:2009 (= HD 60364-5-52:2011, CEI 64-8/5 Annex B, GOST R 50571.5.52-2011, KS C IEC 60364-5-52:2009). Numbering used: B.52.10 = PVC Cu, B.52.11 = PVC Al, B.52.12 = XLPE/EPR Cu, B.52.13 = XLPE/EPR Al (methods E, F, G).

confidence_levels.cross_checked: >= 2 independent sources agree on the cell (NBR 5410 counts as a corroborating source only)
confidence_levels.single_source: only one IEC-2009-based source has the cell
confidence_levels.nbr5410_only: cell exists only in NBR 5410:2004 (built on the older IEC 60364-5-523:1999); IEC 2009 value NOT verified - for B1/B2 >= 150 mm2 the two editions differ, so treat with caution
confidence_levels.conflict_resolved: sources disagree 1:1; chosen value and reason in discrepancies[] - verify on a licensed copy

_meta.independence: GOST, TISOFT, KARMA(F/G and Al-E from KS C IEC), KEC are treated as independent transcriptions. KARMA Cu method E is a copy of TiSoft and was not counted. KARMA A1-D2 values follow an older (Schneider EIG) edition for D1/D2 and several Al cells; they never decided a value.
_meta.not_invented: No value was interpolated or typed from memory. Missing cells are absent (not null-filled).

GOST.what: Machine extraction of GOST R 50571.5.52-2011 (Russian national standard, IDENTICAL to IEC 60364-5-52:2009) from the meganorm.ru text version; 1 erratum corrected by the author (B.52.12 Cu E 3-loaded 50 mm2: text 102 -> 192). Conductor R20 from GOST 22483 (= IEC 60228).

TISOFT.what: Playwright scrape of the TiSoft online reproduction of IEC 60364-5-52:2009 Annex B (https://www.ti-soft.com/en/support/help/electricaldesign/standards/iec-60364-5-52/). Author corrected 2 typos of the TiSoft pages (B.52.11 F 2-loaded 185 mm2 3463 -> 363; B.52.18 0.5 m / 16 circuits 0.38 -> 0.68). Columns col.6 (F flat) and col.8 (G vertical) were scraped but not kept in the published JSON.

KARMA.what: Cable-sizing engine datasets: A1-D2 from 'Schneider Guide Fig G20/G24' (their D1/D2 and Al columns are an OLDER edition - systematically different, see discrepancies); F/G single-core 3-loaded (cols 5 and 7) and Al E from KS C IEC 60364-5-52:2009 (Korean IDT); Cu E copied from TiSoft (not independent).

KEC.what: JSON dump of a Korean KEC calculation workbook, sheet AC cites 'KS C IEC 60364-5-52 B.52.1-B.52.13' (XLPE copper only: B.52.3/B.52.5 A1,A2,B1,B2,D1; B.52.12 cols 2,3,4,6). Sheet CB: conventional tripping multiples.

NBR5410.what: ABNT NBR 5410:2004 tables 36-39 (Brazilian, derived from IEC 60364-5-523:1999 = older IEC edition). Used ONLY as corroboration: it differs from IEC 2009 for B1/B2 >= 150 mm2 and has no XLPE-Al table; some typos (Cu F/G 1.5-2.5 mm2, Al 630 mm2 rows).

LVDS.what: Table B.52.20 (multicore, trays/ladders), horizontal rows only, 'typical published values'.

DESTRO.what: MV cable catalogue data (Ducab/ERA style). Its in-air tray grouping tables are numerically the IEC 60364-5-52 B.52.20/B.52.21 factors; used as second source for those rows only.

MVDP.what: PN-HD 60364-5-52:2011 factor registry (each value double-sourced by the author from LAPP T12, ecalpro.com, SEP Krakow); IEC 60947-2 / 60269-1 conventional currents.

B.52.17_grouping_air.confidence: cross_checked (GOST, TISOFT identical; row 1 also NBR 5410, KARMA, LVDS; rows 2,4 also KARMA)
B.52.17_grouping_air.note: null = not tabulated: IEC states no further reduction for more than 9 circuits/cables in single-layer arrangements (items 2-5).

B.52.18_grouping_direct_in_ground.confidence: cross_checked (GOST, TISOFT; touching row also KARMA; touching n=2..4 also MVDP)
B.52.18_grouping_direct_in_ground.note: Single-core or multicore cables laid directly in the ground (method D2); depth 0.7 m, soil 2.5 K.m/W. The 1.0 at n=1 is implicit.

B.52.19_grouping_in_ducts.note: IEC part A: multicore cables in single-way ducts; part B: single-core cables, one cable per duct (circuits of 2 or 3 single-core cables). Ducts in the ground (method D1), depth 0.7 m, soil 2.5 K.m/W. GOST text repeats the row label 16 where 18 is meant (GOST author's erratum).

B.52.20_multicore_trays.description: Reduction factors for groups of more than one MULTICORE cable on trays/ladders in free air (method E). Rows = number of trays/ladders, columns = number of cables per tray/ladder.

perforated_horizontal_spaced.note: LVDS stores 0.91/0.87/0.85 also in the 9-cable column (its own fill-forward for lookup); the 9-cable cell is left null here because the source does not distinguish a tabulated value from a filled one.

B.52.21_singlecore_trays.description: Reduction factors for groups of more than one circuit of SINGLE-CORE cables (method F), to be applied to the rating of one circuit of single-core cables in free air. Columns = number of three-phase circuits per tray/ladder.
B.52.21_singlecore_trays.warning: DESTRO is an MV catalogue (Ducab-style tables 26-35); the numbers coincide with the IEC 60364-5-52 single-core tray factors as commonly reproduced, but no LV/IEC-labelled second source was found. Treat as unverified.

IEC_60364-4-43_Table_43A_k.description: k for line conductors (adiabatic, S >= I*sqrt(t)/k), IEC 60364-4-43 Table 43A

IEC_60228_class2_R20.note: IEC 60228 class 2 aluminium starts at 10 mm2. shchitovik also lists Al 2.5/4/6 mm2 (12.1/7.41/5.11) from the withdrawn GOST 22483-77 class 1 - NOT IEC 60228, excluded here.
